Oto zaktualizowany kod JavaScript do wklejenia (zamień całą starą sekcję <script> lub dodaj te funkcje).
1. Najpierw dodaj te nowe funkcje (najlepiej na początku sekcji <script> po deklaracjach stałych):
JavaScript// ====================== NOWE FUNKCJE DO STATUS (PIP-BOY) ======================

function updatePipBoy(s, trays) {
  const view = document.getElementById('view-status');
  if (!view || !view.classList.contains('active')) return;

  const t0 = s.temp_chamber || 37.5;
  const hum = s.humidity || 60;
  const t1 = s.temp_aquarium || 37.5;
  const tgt = s.target_temp || 37.5;
  const hMin = s.humidity_target_min || 45;
  const hMax = s.humidity_target_max || 65;

  // Gauge główne
  drawFalloutGauge('pip-temp', t0, 30, 42, tgt-0.4, tgt+0.4, '°C');
  drawFalloutGauge('pip-hum', hum, 30, 90, hMin, hMax, '%');
  drawFalloutGauge('pip-temp1', t1, 30, 42, tgt-0.4, tgt+0.4, '°C');

  // Tace + liczniki
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const tray = trays[i] || {};
    const day = tray.current_day || state.tray[i]?.day || 1;
    const species = tray.species || document.getElementById('main-species-tray'+i)?.value || 'CHICKEN';
    const spData = SPECIES[species] || SPECIES.CHICKEN;

    drawIncubationRing('pip-tray'+i, day, spData.days, spData.lockdown);

    // Liczniki czasu
    const timerEl = document.getElementById('pip-tray'+i+'-timer');
    if (timerEl) {
      const elapsed = (day - 1) * DAY_MS;
      const total = spData.days * DAY_MS;
      const remaining = Math.max(0, total - elapsed);

      const elapsedStr = formatDuration(elapsed);
      const remainStr = '-' + formatDuration(remaining);

      timerEl.innerHTML = `
        Dzień <b>${day}</b>/${spData.days} • ${Math.round((day/spData.days)*100)}%<br>
        <span style="color:#39d35f">${elapsedStr}</span> 
        <span style="color:#f97316">${remainStr}</span>
      `;
    }
  }

  // Kontrolki mocy
  updatePowerIndicators();
}

function formatDuration(ms) {
  const d = Math.floor(ms / DAY_MS);
  const h = Math.floor((ms % DAY_MS) / 3600000);
  const m = Math.floor((ms % 3600000) / 60000);
  return `${d}d ${h}h ${m}m`;
}

function updatePowerIndicators() {
  // Grzałki
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const dot = document.getElementById('dot-h' + i);
    const val = document.getElementById('pip-heater' + i + '-val');
    const sw = document.getElementById('sw-main-h' + i);
    if (sw) sw.checked = !!state.power.heater[i];
    if (dot) dot.className = 'device-dot ' + (state.power.heater[i] ? 'on' : '');
    if (val) val.textContent = (state.runtime.heaterPwm[i] || 0) + '%';
  }

  // Dyfuzor
  const diffDot = document.getElementById('dot-diff');
  const diffSw = document.getElementById('sw-diff');
  if (diffSw) diffSw.checked = !!state.power.diffuser;
  if (diffDot) diffDot.className = 'device-dot ' + (state.power.diffuser ? 'on' : '');

  // Tace
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const sw = document.getElementById('sw-tray' + i);
    if (sw) sw.checked = !!state.power.tray[i];
  }
}
